title: Balanced Binary Tree
description:
Given a binary tree, determine if it is height-balanced . 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/10/06/balance_1.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [3,9,20,null,null,15,7]

Output:
 true
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/10/06/balance_2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [1,2,2,3,3,null,null,4,4]

Output:
 false
```

 Example 3: 
 
```
Input:
 root = []

Output:
 true
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 5000] . 
 
 -10 4 <= Node.val <= 10 4
